about_the_game:
The game stars Shuvani, a nomadic artist beset by tragedy, on her quest for revenge after her family was destroyed by a gestalt of powerful magical energy. Filled with sorrow and resolve, she is left with no choice but to enter the forest, a place where no one dares tread.
Experience the blend of action and strategy in magic and music-based combat.

SHUVANI’S PATH

Utilize your abilities to the fullest and defeat all enemies standing in your way, for you will get only one chance to reach the heart of the forest and fulfill Shuvani's duty. As you overcome the ever-changing challenges this hostile environment presents, you will have the opportunity to add new skills to your toolkit, enabling you to surpass the enemies overwhelming power with your very own.

PERSONALIZE YOUR PLAYSTYLE

  • 4 different archetypes: 2 offensive ones and 2 crowd control
  • More than 20 unique modifiers
  • Stay creative! More than 600 build combinations
  • Experiment with various combos and synergies
  • Explore different approaches to develop effective strategies
  • Scaling difficulty and exciting final battle
  • Unique genre fusion: roguelike, twin stick shooter and the tactical elements of MOBAS.

BREAK THE CYCLE OF HATRED

Unleash your inner power by transforming yourself into an avatar of music and magic to reach a peak of power and evolve your abilities!

Face Zeenon, the Enduring Hatred and avenge Shuvani's family, putting an end to its rampant fury and bringing closure to the tragedy that marked the beginning of her journey.

short_description: Shuvani is a single-player isometric roguelike where action and strategy complement each other in a unique combat system based on magic and music. Unleash your inner power and fulfill your destiny.
